#### Increased Risk of All-Cause Mortality  
The protective functions afforded by vitamin D can be perceived as culminating in perhaps its most important attribute: its capacity to reduce mortality. In addition to single reports suggesting that higher vitamin D levels confer mortality benefits,39-41-43-47'66'67 a number of randomized controlled trial meta-analyses demonstrate the consistency of the inverse relationship between vitamin D level and mortality from any cause.68-72
